section_summary: This section records requests and approvals for Japanese training ships and transports to visit Philippine ports between 1938 and 1940. It follows the Kaio Maru’s revised arrival at Davao, the Tsurumi’s and Shiriya’s proposed stops at Manila for supplies, and the Yakumo and Iwate training squadron’s Manila visit. State, War, and Navy Department correspondence coordinates the usual courtesies and facilities.

people.name: Umataro Tanimoto
people.role: Rear Admiral and commander in chief of the Japanese Training Squadron

subfiles.title: Proposed Kaio Maru visit to Davao
subfiles.about: Requests approval and customary courtesies for Kaio Maru’s training cruise stop at Davao.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador gives the ship’s schedule, crew, and command, and notes that sailing conditions may alter its dates.

subfiles.title: Kaio Maru visit referred to Navy
subfiles.about: Advises Navy of the proposed Kaio Maru visit to Davao.
subfiles.summary: State relays the schedule and ship details and says War is being asked to arrange customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Request for War Department courtesies to Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for Kaio Maru at Davao if War has no objection.
subfiles.summary: State provides the training ship’s schedule, complement, and sailing conditions.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Kaio Maru request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed Davao visit pending federal replies.
subfiles.summary: State will advise the ambassador after consulting interested authorities.

subfiles.title: Approval of Kaio Maru visit
subfiles.about: Confirms approval and usual courtesies for Kaio Maru at Davao.
subfiles.summary: Interested federal authorities agree to the visit.

subfiles.title: Proposed Tsurumi stop at Manila
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Tsurumi to replenish supplies at Manila en route to Borneo.
subfiles.summary: The transport plans to call at Manila January 18–20, 1938.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi visit referred to War
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Tsurumi’s Manila supply stop if War has no objection.
subfiles.summary: State relays the proposed January 18–20 dates.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi visit referred to Navy
subfiles.about: Advises Navy of Tsurumi’s planned Manila supply stop.
subfiles.summary: War is being asked to arrange courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Tsurumi request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Tsurumi’s proposed Manila visit pending federal replies.
subfiles.summary: State has consulted interested authorities.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions to extend courtesies to Kaio Maru at Davao.
subfiles.summary: War notified its Philippine command and Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for Tsurumi
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for customary courtesies to Tsurumi at Manila.
subfiles.summary: War cabled its Philippine command and informed the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Approval of Tsurumi visit
subfiles.about: Confirms federal approval and customary facilities for Tsurumi’s Manila call.
subfiles.summary: The visit is agreeable to interested authorities.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Tsurumi visit
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to Tsurumi’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval officials will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Kaio Maru visit
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to Kaio Maru’s Davao visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval officials will extend customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Revised Kaio Maru arrival date
subfiles.about: Requests acceptance of Kaio Maru’s revised January 29 arrival at Davao.
subfiles.summary: The ship will arrive two days earlier than planned.

subfiles.title: Revised Kaio Maru schedule sent to Navy
subfiles.about: Advises Navy that Kaio Maru will arrive at Davao on January 29.
subfiles.summary: State relays the two-day schedule change.

subfiles.title: Revised Kaio Maru schedule sent to War
subfiles.about: Advises War that Kaio Maru will arrive at Davao on January 29.
subfiles.summary: State relays the two-day schedule change.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of revised Kaio Maru schedule
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Kaio Maru’s revised arrival date.
subfiles.summary: Interested federal departments have been advised.

subfiles.title: War confirmation of revised Kaio Maru schedule
subfiles.about: Confirms Philippine authorities were notified of Kaio Maru’s earlier arrival.
subfiles.summary: War sent a radiogram and copied the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Proposed Yakumo and Iwate visit
subfiles.about: Requests approval for the Japanese Training Squadron to visit Manila for about five days.
subfiles.summary: Exact December dates will follow once scheduled.

subfiles.title: Training squadron visit referred to War
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Yakumo and Iwate at Manila if War has no objection.
subfiles.summary: The proposed visit is for about five days in mid-December.

subfiles.title: Training squadron visit referred to Navy
subfiles.about: Asks Navy to consider the proposed Yakumo and Iwate Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: State says War has been asked to arrange customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of squadron request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed Yakumo and Iwate visit pending federal replies.
subfiles.summary: State will report whether interested authorities approve.

subfiles.title: Approval of training squadron visit
subfiles.about: Approves the Manila visit by Yakumo and Iwate and requests exact dates.
subfiles.summary: Interested authorities will extend customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: War Department approval of squadron visit
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for customary courtesies to Yakumo and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: War informed its Philippine command and Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of squadron visit
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to the Manila visit by Yakumo and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Training squadron’s exact Manila schedule
subfiles.about: Provides the Yakumo and Iwate schedule and names their commanders.
subfiles.summary: The squadron will leave Keelung December 3, reach Manila December 10, and depart December 15.

subfiles.title: Squadron schedule sent to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the training squadron’s exact itinerary and commanders.
subfiles.summary: Yakumo and Iwate will be at Manila December 10–15.

subfiles.title: Squadron schedule sent to War
subfiles.about: Relays the training squadron’s exact itinerary and commanders.
subfiles.summary: Yakumo and Iwate will be at Manila December 10–15.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of squadron schedule
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the squadron’s December 10–15 Manila dates.
subfiles.summary: Authorities have been informed and will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for squadron’s confirmed dates
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for Yakumo and Iwate’s December 10–15 Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: War notified its Philippine command and the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Copy of War arrangements for squadron
subfiles.from: Harry H. Woodring, Secretary of War
subfiles.about: Repeats War’s notice of arrangements for Yakumo and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine command was instructed to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of confirmed squadron dates
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to Yakumo and Iwate’s December 10–15 visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Further copy of War arrangements for squadron
subfiles.from: Harry H. Woodring, Secretary of War
subfiles.about: Repeats War’s notice of arrangements for Yakumo and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine command was instructed to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Proposed Shiriya supply stop
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Shiriya to replenish water and food at Manila.
subfiles.summary: The transport seeks a roughly two-day visit beginning January 24, 1940, including crew landing.

subfiles.title: Shiriya visit referred to Interior
subfiles.about: Advises Interior of Shiriya’s proposed Manila supply stop.
subfiles.summary: State proposes customary courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Shiriya visit referred to Navy
subfiles.about: Advises Navy of Shiriya’s proposed Manila supply stop.
subfiles.summary: State proposes customary courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Shiriya visit referred to War
subfiles.about: Advises War of Shiriya’s proposed Manila supply stop.
subfiles.summary: State proposes customary courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Telegram on Shiriya visit
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Shiriya if Philippine authorities have no objection.
subfiles.summary: The transport plans a two-day Manila supply stop from January 24.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Shiriya request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Shiriya’s proposed Manila stop and conditional courtesies.
subfiles.summary: The High Commissioner may extend facilities if there is no objection.
